lines.text: Three little kittens, they lost their mittens, and they began to cry!
Oh mother dear, our paws are freezing cold outside!
Put on your mittens! But did you know mittens don't actually make any heat?
Your own body makes warm heat like a little internal furnace!
Fluffy wool fibers trap millions of microscopic pockets of still air!
Trapped air is a super insulator that stops cold air from stealing your warmth!
And inside mittens, your fingers huddle together to share their heat!
Now you know the cozy physics behind Three Little Kittens and their mittens!
